# Refusals: exit 1, empty stdout and exactly one value-free diagnostic
# naming the field path and source position. Nothing is dropped silently.

! skycompat import $IMPORT/refuse/run.yaml
! stdout .
stderr '\Atask yaml: unsupported run at 1:6: requires a shell\n\z'
env EXIT
stdout '^EXIT=1$'

! skycompat import --shell /bin/sh $IMPORT/refuse/workdir-dollar.yaml --workdir-ref $IMPORT/workdir-ref.json
stderr '\Ausage:'
! skycompat import --shell /bin/sh --workdir-ref $IMPORT/workdir-ref.json $IMPORT/refuse/workdir-dollar.yaml
! stdout .
stderr '\Atask yaml: unsupported workdir at 1:10: environment substitution\n\z'
